parsed.justification: Both rationales correctly interpret the scoring rubric, identify the same weakness in the comment (unclear connection between 3.2 and 3.3, suggestion to drop multi-view learning), and align on a score of 4. Both are well-grounded in the text, noting the specific actionable suggestion and its partial lack of depth. Each loses a point on unsupported-claim control: Rationale A says the comment 'provides a clear justification for why this connection is confusing,' which slightly overstates—the comment's justification is that the reviewer 'did not fully grasp' it, which is subjective; Rationale B says the comment 'provides justification for this suggestion,' similarly overstating the depth of justification. Both are otherwise solid assessments.
